title: Medication category is so nice but it needs improving
body:
I use the medication category every day but there is a major flaw. If you have many daily madecations and your daily routine is also flexible it's very annoying to mark a daily medication as taken if midnight has passed. It shoud be possible to mark the medication as taked and mark the timing for next day. 

For exsample I have the timing for 22:00 but some times my day is very long and it's possible that I can take it when it's the next day and 1:00 am. But I can't mark it as taken so I mark it for 23:59 and write a note to another app that I took it later. If this is not iprived I probably will develope my own app tho I sctually like this one and it's the first app I've used for medications.

title: Eating disorders forgotten yet again
body:
Would love to use this ”health” app to track sleep and for preagnancy planning, but it forces some energy consumption hilights on me. I never asked these calory consumption hilights. Yet, I receive them and I am not able to opt out from these calory consumption hilights either. Hence, the app is unusable for a one with ED background.

I find it very confusing that an app that supposedly takes into account so many different health concerns do not have a super simple feature to configure not to receive notes about your energy consumption. Talking about internalized diet culture.

title: It’s a data delivery service, not an app
body: It takes in data from apps and it delivers data to apps. The actual UI is… not good. It gives you a snapshot of some metrics and if you want more, it just dumps you into the individual data entry list. Some features, like Cardio Fitness level, just don’t work at all. Take an uphill walk – your fitness is low, take a downhill walk – congrats, you’re an athlete! But the worst thing is that it has all the data but you need a 3rd party subscription app to make any sense of it.
